title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: admins deploy and govern MCP-based agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The documented controls and preview automation are supported, and the briefing correctly distinguishes current Learn guidance from the overdue roadmap target. Minor corrections should put the deciding API properties in the table notes and acknowledge differences between Microsoft's documentation pages.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans deployment, monitoring and management of MCP-built agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center for secure enterprise use.
claims.quote: Admins can deploy, monitor, and manage agents built with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in the M365 admin center for secure enterprise use.
